description: Ferry Terminal locations is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Council’s ferry terminal locations by street, suburb, terminal name, latitude, longitude, accessibility, parking, nearby bus services, CityCat or CityFerry service and much more. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Assets and Facilities. Its keywords are arcgis, assets, public transport, spatial data, ferry, transport. The portal shows 22 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
